incidents.body: This incident has been resolved. The underlying configuration mapping errors, connection saturation, and TLS handshake failures have been fully addressed. incidents.body: The email provider's corporate account experienced a temporary access block, affecting the delivery of login emails, reports, and system notifications. We have implemented the changes requested by the provider and are configuring additional safeguards for other platform features, as well as setting up preventive alerts to ensure a rapid response should the issue recur. We are implementing a new configuration to restructure workflows, ensuring that any email delivery inconsistencies do not impact or compromise other system functions. Preventive alert rules have been established to immediately notify the technical team if this behavior recurs with the provider. Communication channels and technical investigations involving both the provider and internal teams remain active to ensure the situation is fully and permanently stabilized. To resolve the incident, we carried out the adjustments and configurations required to unblock and restore the corporate account. This included unblocking and validating essential system emails, reports, and portal emails, as well as reconfiguring email integration routes passing through the gateway to ensure smooth traffic flow without affecting other platform features. We also monitored environment testing and confirmed that email receipt had returned to normal for affected customers. Next steps: An internal meeting will be held tomorrow among the responsible teams to evaluate and define the next steps for resuming email services, ensuring a safe and controlled reactivation.
incidents.title: Widespread Failure in Sending and Receiving Emails

incidents.body: We identified that customers were experiencing slow bot response times, with delays ranging from 10 seconds to a full minute. The technical team mobilized to validate the issue and investigate the environment's logs. We performed a rollback of the application update that had been intended to improve the platform. We appreciate everyone's patience and cooperation while we addressed this situation.

incidents.body: The environment has been fully restored to normal and is stable, with message flow and history back to normal. Our technical teams increased the processing capacity of the messaging queues to eliminate bottlenecks and resolved discrepancies regarding message history persistence. Normal operations were restored at 9:50 PM yesterday, and the system remained under continuous monitoring until 9:30 AM today to fully validate performance. The emergency response has concluded, and the platform remains under standard preventive monitoring.

What happened and what was the impact on customers:
We identified a failure in the AI application. As a result, customers experienced a failure in the messages from the AI-powered bots.

Actions taken:
Update of the expired token
Restart Rollout in all pods
Monitoring of metrics after restarts

Failure occurrences:
Start of failure: 11/12/2025 8:10 AM (GMT-3)
Fault resolution: 11/12/2025 10:10 AM (GMT-3)

Root cause
The failure was caused by instabilities resulting from expired credentials on an external service, which temporarily impacted the bot's operation.
